library.name: DIYables TFT SPI
library.author: DIYables.io
library.sentence: Arduino library for SPI TFT LCD displays (ILI9341, ILI9488, ST7789) with optional XPT2046 / HR2046 / ADS7843 touch support.
library.paragraph: Works with both touch and non-touch versions of the same SPI TFT modules. Supports ILI9341 (240x320, 16-bit RGB565), ILI9488 (320x480, 18-bit RGB666), and ST7789 (240x320, 16-bit RGB565) displays over SPI. Includes built-in driver for XPT2046 / HR2046 / ADS7843 SPI touch controllers and 4-wire resistive touch panels - no separate touch library required. Use the display-only API for non-touch panels, or add initTouchSPI() to enable touch on modules that include a touch controller. Extends Adafruit GFX for full graphics support. Works with any Arduino-compatible board that has SPI.

library.name: HDrive
library.author: Jesús Amezquita, Kame Electronics
library.sentence: H Bridge architecture based driver controller.
library.paragraph: Library for controlling nearly any motor driver based on an H Bridge architecture, being 100% compatible with independent two channel PWM, braking and freerun.
